scenes.headline: How one flow model makes image, video, sound and action
scenes.sub: FLUX 3: flow matching, and joint attention over one token sequence.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Oboe! Every FLUX before this was an image model. FLUX 3 makes image, video with sound, and robot action from one backbone.

scenes.text: One flow-matching model learns image, video, audio and action together, so each modality constrains the others: the sound has to match the impact.
scenes.say: The idea: learn every modality in one model, so each constrains the others. The sound has to match the impact; the motion has to obey the mass.

items.text: Draw a straight line, noise to data
items.say: In training, the path from noise to data is a straight line. The network learns the velocity along it.

items.text: Step from noise along the velocity
items.say: To generate, start from noise and step along the velocity. Each step is a full pass of a huge transformer.

items.text: A straight field lands in few steps
items.say: If the field is straight, a few steps still land on the data. That's what makes twenty seconds of video tractable.

steps.label: Per-modality attention
steps.note: image, video, audio, action: each sees only itself
steps.say: Per-modality attention lets each token see only its own kind: four models in a trenchcoat.

steps.label: Joint attention
steps.note: any token can attend to any other
steps.say: Joint attention lets any token see any other. An audio token can attend to the video frame that made the sound.
Each modality goes through its own encoder, and all of them become tokens in a single sequence.
One multimodal transformer runs over that whole sequence, with a text encoder conditioning it from the side.

steps.note: the action lane is marked extensible
steps.say: Shared decoders read each modality back out. Action is just one more lane, marked extensible.

scenes.title: Human preference for FLUX 3 video, win rate
scenes.say: In its maker's preliminary tests, raters picked it ninety-three percent of the time over one rival, and fifty-two over another: nearly a tie.

scenes.text: Joint attention lets modalities constrain each other; a straight flow makes twenty seconds of it tractable.

recap: A straight flow lands in few steps
Every modality in one sequence, one attention
Action is one more lane on the same backbone
scenes.say: To recap: a straight flow, one joint sequence, and one backbone for every modality.
